item.title: ESA's Juice uses Earth as slingshot toward Jupiter
item.description: ESA's Juice spacecraft passed Earth on September 28, using the planet's gravity to reshape its path to Jupiter without using fuel.

item.title: Leucine supports muscle and cellular energy
item.description: The amino acid leucine boosts cellular energy by protecting key mitochondrial proteins from destruction, researchers found.
